With sprinter David Rees, John and Bob Hamilton over the 'half' and 'quarter' and new members Michael and Trevor Day and John Crockford over the longer distances, we have the makings of a first class Youth team.

Robert Hamilton ran second leg and took us up 5 positions to 12th handing over to brother John who gained one more place. Geoff Rosam ran the final leg for us, but as Geoff has yet to find his best form this year, he was unable to hold his position and so we finally came home in 14th place.
Robert Hamilton ran well on the first stage for Belgrave 'A' to bring us in a well placed 12th. Only 17 seconds behind was John Crockford who had run a stormer for the 'B' team.
Robert & John Hamilton at Somerset House trying to change their name to Gorman.
None of the boys were at their best and we were never in the hunt for medals. Robert Hamilton 17.03 Vic Butcher 16.12
Third place went to Robert Hamilton who also ran well. Eddy McNally had by far his best run ever and will in the weeks ahead be a force to be reckoned with.
